Report DescriptionRECEIVED BY THE NATIONAL COMMAND CENTER (NCC) AMPLIFYING INFORMATION: - USCG SECTOR ANCHORAGE INITIATED A CIC AFTER RECEIVING A MAYDAY CALL FROM F/V TENACIOUS REPORTING THAT THEY WERE TAKING ON WATER AND ABANDONING SHIP. - USCG ANCHORAGE ISSUED UMIB AND BRIEFED FOR MH-60 LAUNCH FROM KODIAK. - GOOD SAMARITAN F/V GRAND PA ANSWERED UMIB AND WAS ON-SCENE WITHIN 10 MINUTES. - 05 CREWMEMBERS ABANDONED SHIP TO SKIFF AND WERE RESCUED BY F/V GRAND PA. - SAR SURVIVOR DEBRIEF CONDUCTED, VERIFIED NO FURTHER PIWS AND TOTAL LOSS OF F/V (ESTIMATED $750K). - CREW WAS ASLEEP ON AUTOPILOT WHEN VESSEL STRUCK A SUBMERGED OBJECT. - THERE IS NO MAJOR MEDIA ATTENTION. - THERE IS NO HAZARD TO NAVIGATION. - MSU VALDEZ NOTIFIED FOR ENVIRONMENTAL CONCERNS, ESTIMATED 2,000 GALLONS OF DIESEL ONBOARD. - THE CIC PROCESS WAS STOOD DOWN.
